name: Ghazghkull Thraka
_source_note: Matches the Ghazghkull Thraka datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page (Orks app v2.7.1), read 2026-10-12. The unit is now a single model: Makari is no longer a model with his own profile, only a token for the Makari, Hoist Dat Banner! ability, and the datasheet no longer has the Leader ability.
_keywords_note: Exactly the printed KEYWORDS line. The datasheet's own name also counts as a keyword (core rules 02.01.01); the app adds that itself, so GHAZGHKULL THRAKA is deliberately not listed here.
_loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Adamantine ’Eadbutt; 1 Gork’s Klaw; 1 Mork’s Roar. Mork’s Roar is one weapon with two profiles.

ranged.name: Mork’s Roar - Aimed
ranged.weaponGroupLabel: Before selecting targets with this weapon, select one of its profiles to make attacks with.

_factionAbilities_note: The datasheet's ARMY RULES line: Da Boss, Waaagh!
